_comment: Mighty Networks Admin API (https://docs.mightynetworks.com/admin-api). Base https://api.mn.co/admin, Bearer token auth, page/per_page pagination (max 100). Network id 4022250 = lesko-help-2. node_fields lists candidate source field names - the first present in the API response wins; the daily run logs the real member object keys so this mapping can be tightened after the first snapshot.
_fields_note: Verified 2026-08-18 from the first live run: the member object exposes exactly [ambassador_level, avatar, bio, categories, created_at, email, first_name, id, last_name, location, member_type, permalink, referral_count, time_zone, updated_at]. created_at = joined the Network (per docs). There is NO last-visit field in Admin API v1 today - last_visited stays empty until Mighty exposes one (candidates kept so it lights up automatically); updated_at is captured to test empirically whether it tracks member activity.
